name: Med-Ball Rotational Scoop Throw
description: Rotational scoop throw — power through the hip-to-shoulder kinetic chain, mimicking a hook, hip toss entry, or takedown drive.
instructions_excerpt: Stand sideways to a sturdy wall, 4-6 feet away. Hold a medicine ball at the lead hip with both hands. Rotate hips explosively and throw the ball at the wall as if scooping it across the body. Catch the rebound with soft elbows. 5-8 throws per side.

name: Medicine Ball Rotational Throw
description: Rotational power output for golfers, tennis players, baseball — anywhere hips drive the swing.
instructions_excerpt: Stand sideways to a wall, 3-5 feet away, holding a med ball at chest height. Rotate away then explosively rotate through the hips and throw the ball into the wall. Catch the rebound and repeat.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
description: Full-body rotational-free power output.
instructions_excerpt: Stand holding a slam ball or soft med ball overhead. Extend up tall, then rapidly contract the core and drive the ball into the floor in front of you. Pick it up and repeat.

name: Medicine-Ball Rotation Slam (Spike Sim)
description: Rotational med-ball slam — simulates the water-polo shot and spearfishing aim-rotation.
instructions_excerpt: Stand feet shoulder-width, med-ball at chest. Rotate to one side loading the hip. Rotate back and slam the ball in front at the same angle. Reset. Alternate sides.

name: Medicine-Ball Rotational Toss (Shotgun Swing)
description: Rotational power toss mimicking the shotgun swing — transverse-plane explosiveness for clay sports.
instructions_excerpt: Stand sideways to a wall, feet shoulder-width. Hold a med ball at waist level. Rotate the trunk and throw the ball hard into the wall across the body. Catch the rebound; repeat.

name: Muscle-Up Transition Drill
description: Chest-to-bar high pull + transition — specific drill for the calisthenics muscle-up.
instructions_excerpt: From a dead hang, perform an explosive pull that brings the chest above the bar. At the peak, drive elbows back and transition over the bar into a dip support.

name: Nordic Diagonal-Stride Bound
description: Running-bound drill with opposite arm-leg extension — classic nordic skiing specific.
instructions_excerpt: Bound forward, pushing off one leg while driving opposite arm forward. Land on the other leg with contralateral arm back. 20-30 m.

name: Overhead Medicine Ball Throw (Forward)
description: Full-body explosive throw for tennis/baseball power transfer.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with feet hip-width holding a med ball overhead. Load hips into a quarter squat, then explosively extend hips, knees, and arms to throw the ball forward as hard as possible.

name: Paraglide Take-Off Run Drill
description: Downhill running with arms overhead — paraglider-specific launch sim.
instructions_excerpt: On a gentle downslope, run 15-20 m with both arms raised overhead as if inflating a wing. Keep steady speed. 4-6 reps.

name: Parkour Precision Jump to Line
description: Two-foot jump to stick — parkour's foundational landing accuracy drill.
instructions_excerpt: Mark a target line ~1-1.5m away. From two feet, jump and stick the landing on the line with both feet hitting simultaneously. Hold for 2 seconds. Reset and repeat.

name: Parkour Precision-Jump Landing
description: Small precision-jump to stick — parkour-specific accuracy and landing absorption.
instructions_excerpt: Place a small marker 3-5 ft forward. Jump with both feet, stick the landing with zero extra steps, hold 2-3 sec. 6-10 reps.

name: Pogo Hops
description: Stiff-leg hops — calf-Achilles reactive work, essential for sprinting and jumping.
instructions_excerpt: Stand tall. With straight (stiff) legs, hop up and down on the balls of the feet, minimizing ground contact. Small hops, fast tempo.

name: Pogo Hops (Ski-Specific Ankle Stiffness)
description: Pure ankle-stiffness plyometric — foundation for running, bounding, and ski-boot control.
instructions_excerpt: Small continuous hops in place, bouncing off the balls of the feet. Keep knees nearly straight — power comes from the calves and Achilles. 20-30 sec sets.

name: Pop-Up Plank to Standing (Surf Transition)
description: Surf-style pop-up drill — trains the plank-to-standing transition for surfing and wakeboarding.
instructions_excerpt: Lie prone, hands planted chest-high. In one motion, press up and swing feet under the body to land in a surf stance. Stand tall, reset. 8-10 reps.

name: Power Clean
description: Olympic lifting derivative — pulls a barbell from the floor to the shoulders in a quarter squat.
instructions_excerpt: Set up with a barbell over mid-foot, hip hinge to grip. Explosively extend hips, knees, and ankles while shrugging the shoulders. Drop into a quarter squat and catch the bar on the front deltoids.

name: Power Snatch
description: Snatch caught above parallel — wide-grip overhead lift from the floor.
instructions_excerpt: Set up over the bar with wide snatch grip. Pull off the floor smoothly, explode at the hips, then pull under and catch the bar locked out overhead in a partial squat. Stand.

name: Push Jerk
description: Push press with a re-bend under the bar — receives load with bent knees, drives up to lockout.
instructions_excerpt: Dip and drive as in a push press. As the bar leaves the shoulders, drop fast into a partial squat with arms locked overhead, then stand to finish.

name: Push Press
description: Overhead barbell press with a leg-drive dip — moves heavier load than strict press.
instructions_excerpt: Front-rack the bar. Small fast dip at the knees (10-15°), then drive vertically through the legs to launch the bar overhead. Finish with arms straight and feet planted.

name: Push-Up Plyo (Wrist Fall Prep)
description: Reactive push-up — builds upper-body shock tolerance for the inevitable skater fall.
instructions_excerpt: From a push-up position, explosively push off the floor so hands leave briefly. Land softly with slightly bent elbows and repeat. Progress to clap push-ups.

name: Race-Pace Strides
description: Short race-pace strides — speed maintenance for all running disciplines.
instructions_excerpt: After easy warm-up, run 6-10 strides of 80-100 m at race pace with full recovery between. Keep form relaxed.

name: Racquetball Quick-Reaction Drill
description: Reaction drop-catch drill — racquetball/squash quick-hand prep.
instructions_excerpt: Partner drops a ball. React, catch before second bounce. 20-30 reps, alternating sides.

name: Reactive Lateral Shuffle with Cone
description: Partner- or cue-driven lateral shuffle between cones — court-reactive movement for pickleball/tennis dinking and pickup.
instructions_excerpt: Set up two cones 6-10 feet apart. In athletic stance, shuffle toward whichever cone a partner points at or calls out. Change direction quickly on each call. 20-30 seconds per bout. Rest and repeat.

name: Reactive Start Drill
description: Start-on-cue explosive drill — handler-side speed for dog-agility and bikejoring starts.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in an athletic stance. On a partner's or timer's cue, explode into a 10-15 ft sprint or first stride. Reset and repeat. Short, quality reps only.

name: Roller-Derby Hip-Whip Turn
description: Hip-whip agility pattern — roller-derby specific lateral change.
instructions_excerpt: From a crouched athletic stance, pivot hips sharply 90 deg one direction, then the other. 15-20 reps.

name: Roller-Ski Double-Pole Bound
description: Bounding with double-pole arms — roller-skiing and nordic skating specific.
instructions_excerpt: Bound forward with both arms reaching then driving back hard. 6-10 bounds per set.

name: Rotational Med Ball Wall Throw
description: Rotational power throw into a wall — captures the paddle-drive and surf-turn moment without heavy CNS load.
instructions_excerpt: Stand perpendicular to a wall, about 3 feet out. Rotate away from the wall, then drive through the hips to throw the ball into the wall with both hands. Catch and repeat.

name: Rotational Med-Ball Slam
description: Slam med ball downward and to the side — full-body rotational power with ground contact finish.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with feet shoulder-width, med ball overhead. Rotate to one side and slam the ball down hard next to the opposite foot. Catch the rebound (or pick up), rotate to the other side, slam. Alternate for reps.

name: Rotational Med-Ball Slam (Ice-Axe Swing)
description: Transverse-plane slam — builds the rotational power needed for ice-climbing axe swings and freestyle ski rotations.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with feet hip-width, holding a slam ball. Rotate the torso, loading one hip. Drive the ball down and across to slam at the far ankle. Catch, reset, repeat. Alternate sides.

name: Rotational Med-Ball Throw (Golf-Specific)
description: Explosive rotational med-ball throw — golf and disc-golf swing power.
instructions_excerpt: Stand sideways to a wall holding a med ball at chest. Rotate and throw the ball hard into the wall. Catch, reset, repeat.

name: Rotational Med-Ball Wall Pass
description: Side-facing med ball pass to a wall — pure rotational power with elastic return.
instructions_excerpt: Stand 3-5 feet from a wall, sideways. Hold a med ball at the chest. Rotate explosively toward the wall and throw the ball at a chest-high target. Catch the rebound and repeat quickly. 8-10 per side.

name: Rotational Scoop Toss (Med Ball)
description: Low-to-high rotational throw — baseball/softball hitting power and hockey slap-shot mechanics.
instructions_excerpt: Stand sideways to a wall with feet wider than shoulders. Hold a med ball at hip height on the outside hip. Rotate through the trail hip and scoop/throw the ball upward and into the wall. Catch rebound and reset.

name: Sandboard Squat-Pop Sim
description: Dryland squat-pop drill simulating sandboard / mountain-board descent stance.
instructions_excerpt: Assume a wide athletic stance. Squat deep, then pop up and land in the same stance. 8-10 reps. Small rotation on landing.

name: Short Hill Bounding
description: Exaggerated bounding uphill — running-specific power and stride length.
instructions_excerpt: Bound uphill exaggerating each stride, arms driving. 10-15 bounds per rep. 4-6 reps. Walk down.

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Swing (Golf Power)
description: Unilateral KB swing — asymmetric hinge power for golf and golf-fitness.
instructions_excerpt: Hike a KB one-handed between legs, snap the hips to drive it chest-high. Catch in the same hand. 10 per side.

name: Single-Leg Bound
description: Unilateral horizontal plyo — stride-specific power for running, cutting, serving.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg. Explosively hop forward as far as possible, landing on the SAME leg. Absorb landing, then switch legs. 3-5 bounds per leg.

name: Single-Leg Broad Jump (to Stick)
description: Unilateral horizontal jump with a stuck landing — builds confidence in single-leg force absorption (court deceleration).
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg. Counter-movement into an explosive horizontal jump, landing on the SAME leg. Stick the landing with quiet foot and absorbed hip. Reset. 3-5 per side.

name: Single-Leg Hop (Dance Tempo)
description: Single-leg rhythmic hop — plyometric base for Irish, hip-hop, contemporary.
instructions_excerpt: Hop on one leg for 10-20 reps in place, emphasizing quiet feet and tempo. Switch legs.

name: Single-Leg Lateral Bound to Stick
description: Unilateral lateral hop with stuck landing — hockey stride power and lateral cutting athleticism.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg. Explosively hop sideways as far as possible onto the opposite leg. Stick the landing for a 2-count. Reset and hop back.

name: Skater Jump (Lateral Bound)
description: Lateral plyometric bound — ski, tennis, and change-of-direction sports essential.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg, slightly bent. Leap laterally to the opposite leg, sticking the landing soft. Pause 1s to establish stability. Leap back. Continue rhythm once mechanics are clean.

name: Ski Imitation Bounds
description: Lateral jumping imitation drill used by XC skiers and biathletes — trains double-push stride rhythm.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in athletic stance. Bound laterally from one foot to the other, pushing off explosively and driving the opposite arm. Land soft and repeat immediately. 20-30 m sets.

name: Snatch
description: Full snatch — bar from floor to overhead in one move, catch in deep squat.
instructions_excerpt: Set up over the bar with wide snatch grip. Pull, extend, and pull under aggressively, catching the bar overhead in a full overhead squat. Stand to finish.

name: Snatch Balance
description: Barbell drops into overhead squat from behind-the-neck position — Olympic weightlifting positional drill for receiving the snatch.
instructions_excerpt: Bar on the back with a wide snatch grip. Dip the knees slightly, drive the bar up while dropping into an overhead squat, catching with locked-out arms in a full squat. Stand with the bar overhead.

name: Split Squat Jump
description: Single-leg explosive power — advanced plyo for ski, skating, running.
instructions_excerpt: Drop into a lunge position. Explosively jump, switching legs mid-air, landing in the opposite lunge. Absorb the landing, then repeat.

name: Split-Stance Explosive Press
description: Split-stance overhead med-ball push-press — single-leg base stability plus explosive overhead finish.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in a split stance with a med ball at the chest. Dip the back knee slightly, then drive up through the front leg and press-throw the ball straight overhead. Catch or drop and reset. 5-6 per stance side.

name: Squat Jump (Counter-Movement)
description: Vertical counter-movement jump — athletic power baseline.
instructions_excerpt: Stand tall. Quickly drop into a quarter squat, then explode straight up as high as possible. Land soft with bent knees.

name: Stone-to-Shoulder
description: Atlas stone or heavy sandbag lifted from the ground to shoulder — strongman event-specific lift combining deadlift, clean, and shouldering.
instructions_excerpt: Straddle the stone/sandbag. Squat and wrap arms around it. Pull it onto the lap, then stand and continue the pull, rolling it up the chest and flipping it onto the shoulder. Alternate shoulders across sets.

name: Surfer Pop-Up Drill
description: Dryland pop-up — explosive prone-to-stance transition that is the foundational surf movement.
instructions_excerpt: Lie prone on a mat as if on a board. From a push-up position, explosively pop both feet forward under the body, landing in a surf stance (front foot angled, knees bent). Reset to prone. Repeat.

name: Table-Tennis Footwork Shadow Drill
description: Side-shuffle + swing-shadow — table-tennis/beach-tennis/racquetball footwork.
instructions_excerpt: Side-shuffle left, shadow backhand. Side-shuffle right, shadow forehand. 30-45s sets, 4 rounds.

name: Tack-Transition Footwork Drill
description: Side-to-side quick footwork drill — sailing tack maneuver practice on dryland.
instructions_excerpt: Set two marks 3 m apart. Side-shuffle + duck (simulating the boom) + continue to the other mark. Reverse. 30-45s sets.

name: Taekwondo Round Kick Drill
description: Repeated round-house kick drill — taekwondo-specific hip rotation and kick speed.
instructions_excerpt: Standing by a kicking bag, throw 10 round kicks per side, alternating target heights (low, mid, high). Reset stance after each.

name: Team-Handball Jump-and-Throw
description: Jumping ball throw — team-handball specific offensive motion.
instructions_excerpt: Running approach, one-foot take-off, throw a med ball (3-5 kg) hard into a wall. Catch rebound or reset. 4-6 reps per side.

name: Team-Handball Jump-Throw
description: Running jump-shot throw drill — team-handball-specific jump-land mechanics.
instructions_excerpt: Run 3 steps, jump off lead leg, release a simulated throw at peak, land on other leg and stabilize. 6-8 per side.

name: Tire Flip
description: Large-tire flip — hybrid deadlift-clean-push movement central to strongman and highland games event prep.
instructions_excerpt: Squat low to the tire with chest against it, hands under the bottom edge. Drive through the legs to lift and rotate, then transition the hands and push the tire over. Walk around and repeat.

name: Track Sprint Build 60s
description: Progressive 60 m sprint — primary masters-sprint neuromuscular session.
instructions_excerpt: Build from 50% to ~90% effort across 60 m. Walk back recovery. 6-10 reps.

name: Trap Bar Jump Squat
description: Loaded jump squat with a trap bar — joint-friendly version of a loaded jump, builds hip power with minimal spinal compression.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in a trap bar holding the handles. Drop to a quarter squat and explode upward, leaving the floor if load allows. Land soft. Use 25-40% of trap bar deadlift max for load.

name: Tuck Jump
description: Vertical jump with tucked knees to chest — explosive leg power + core.
instructions_excerpt: Stand tall. Quickly drop and explode upward, tucking the knees to the chest at apex. Land soft and repeat.

name: Vault Kong Progression
description: Entry parkour vault pattern over a low obstacle — builds shoulder push + hip compression.
instructions_excerpt: Run up to a waist-high object. Place both hands on top, tuck knees to chest between the hands, and pass both legs through to land on the far side.

name: Volleyball Approach Jump
description: Three-step spike approach into a max vertical — sport-specific plyo for volleyball hitters.
instructions_excerpt: Set a target overhead (wall mark or net). From 3-4 steps out, take the classic 3-step approach (L-R-L for right-handers), plant both feet, swing arms, and jump as high as possible. Reach with the hitting arm. Land soft and reset.

name: Volleyball Blocking Jump-Land
description: Vertical block-jump with solid land — volleyball/beach-volleyball specific.
instructions_excerpt: From athletic stance at net, explosive vertical jump with arms reaching, land soft into quarter squat. 5-8 reps.

name: Wall-Climb Practice (OCR)
description: Timed wall-climb rehearsal — OCR event-specific skill.
instructions_excerpt: Find a 5-7 ft wall or sturdy box. Run in and climb up with a single leap-and-pull. Drop off the far side. 6-8 reps.
